Recording rights
US public domain: the original Victor 66016 issue was publicly advertised for sale by 16 June 1922, before the 1925 cutoff. Documented

Programme rule 2. The Morning Oregonian of 16 June 1922, page 8, advertises Victor Red Seal 66016, Prelude in C-sharp minor, Rachmaninoff, at $1.25. DAHR links the two candidate 1921 takes to both original single-faced 66016 and later double-faced 814. The source rights year 1922 is a demonstrated publication bound, not the session year or the contradictory Victor 814 MARC [1920] date. This transfer’s take remains unresolved; no modern free licence is inferred from the Archive upload.

Prelude in C♯ minor, Op. 3 No. 2; Sergei Rachmaninoff, piano, recorded 1921. Original Victor 66016 publicly advertised by 16 June 1922; transferred from Victor 814. US public-domain recording. Source: Internet Archive. Rights statement

  1. Internet Archive — recording item — Recording attribution, source, date, licence and transfer description; not the upload date.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  2. DAHR — Victor B-25650 — Take 3: 14 October 1921; take 13: 13 December 1921; both issued on Victor 66016 and Victor 814. This identifies the same recording candidates across original and later catalogue numbers.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  3. DAHR — Victor 814 — Both 1921 takes are listed. Its autogenerated MARC [1920] conflicts with the recorded-take chronology and is not used as a session date.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  4. The Morning Oregonian, 16 June 1922, page 8 — Wiley B. Allen advertisement — Dated newspaper page; Wiley B. Allen Co. record advertisement, Red Seal Records list, second row: 66016, Prelude in C Sharp Minor, Rachmaninoff, $1.25. Contemporary proof of public availability by this date.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  5. US Copyright Office — pre 1972 sound recordings — Recordings first published before 1923 and the annual expiration schedule for 1923–⁠1946 publications; as of 2026 the cutoff is 1925.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
